etymology.root: Named for Adolf Brix, the nineteenth-century German scientist who refined the scale

text.what: Sugar in the juice, as a percentage by weight. Pickers read it off a refractometer in the row, and it is the number most arguments about picking dates are conducted in — usually alongside acid and pH, which matter as much.

kin.as: A grape that can hit sugar before its stems and skins are ready.
The decision the number feeds into.
